description: Land Acquisition - Compensations to 7 allotments of land in Akurana D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices under Section 33 of the Land Acquisition Act regarding statutory compensation payments for specific land acquisitions. It includes detailed land information such as plot names, numbers, extents, and boundary descriptions. The content is exclusively focused on land acquisition and compensation matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related administrative notices.
